description: Source code implementing resource management for SRS (Sounding Reference Signal) in 5G NR DU (Distributed Unit), including resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration for UL slots, with handling for TDD and FDD configurations.

classes.name: du_srs_policy_max_ul_rate::cell_context
classes.description: Represents the context for SRS resource management per cell, including configuration parameters and resource lists.

methods.name: du_srs_policy_max_ul_rate::alloc_resources
methods.description: Allocates SRS resources for a group of UEs, assigning resources based on availability and policy.

methods.name: du_srs_policy_max_ul_rate::dealloc_resources
methods.description: Deallocates SRS resources for a group of UEs, freeing resources and resetting configurations.

methods.name: du_srs_policy_max_ul_rate::cell_context::find_optimal_ue_srs_resource
methods.description: Finds the optimal SRS resource for a UE based on a weighted policy considering reuse and slot occupancy.
